description: Answers, guides and news about the games.

webgl.title: Test this browser's 3D support
webgl.intro: This asks your browser for 3D graphics the same way a game does, and shows you what it answers.

verdict.accelerated: Your browser is drawing 3D graphics with the graphics card. The 3D games should work here.
verdict.software: Your browser can draw 3D graphics, but it is using the processor instead of the graphics card. The 3D games will run, but they will feel slow.
verdict.blocked: Your browser would not give us 3D graphics at all, so the 3D games cannot run in it.

webgl.errorUnknown: Your browser did not say why.

yahtzeeOdds.title: Work out your own odds
yahtzeeOdds.intro: Say how many dice already show the same face and how many rolls you have left in the turn.
yahtzeeOdds.chance: chance of finishing five of a kind, or about 1 in {count}.
yahtzeeOdds.certain: Five of a kind already. Nothing left to roll for.

cta.title: Free games, straight from your browser
cta.text: Bloob.io has multiplayer games for two players or a full table, with bots to fill the empty seats. No account and no download needed.
